title: Three-index H1 body-engulfing control-transfer response

research_height.transfer_path: A threshold-free two-bar directional-control transfer must first prove dense doubled-spread response economics across three indices before one additive Optimization information seed can exist.

central_question: Does a strict opposite-colour H1 body engulfing event across US30, US100 and US500 produce a sufficiently dense and temporally broad four-hour continuation or reversion response after doubled spread cost to justify one later additive-alpha Optimization information seed?

why_now.optimization_bottleneck: The qualified paired-month anchor still needs independent alpha and actual lifecycle starts. Static weights, capital ladders, account drawdown controls, component outcome states, protective stops, shared-capital ownership and the exact market-state router are closed.
why_now.new_data_role: The complete three-symbol H1 surface was previously consumed only at fixed predecision clocks for participation or deficit-day relative state. Its continuous all-clock two-body control-transfer geometry and following executable-open response have not been calculated.
why_now.decision_if_true: Retain exactly one fixed three-index continuation or reversion information seed for a separately owned Optimization proxy-first combination after another full-map comparison.
why_now.decision_if_false: Preserve the current anchor and close this exact body-engulfing continuation/reversion mechanism with no adjacent body ratio, wick, threshold, hold, clock, symbol or direction subgroup rescue.

whole_map_recomparison.program_1: Selected despite recent concentration because the anchor's remaining measured bottleneck is independent entry supply and the complete H1 surface now supports a new full-clock body-control-transfer role rather than an existing component or router transform.
whole_map_recomparison.program_2: VIX, rates, breadth, positioning, reserves, options expiration, macro calendar and credit-supply roles are closed with no retained seed or new causal external field.
whole_map_recomparison.program_3: Entry clocks, week edges, DST mismatch, carry, crowding, handoff, passive priority and delay are closed; no new order or synchronized quote-recovery input is present.
whole_map_recomparison.program_4: Native hold, adverse exit, stop, peer-exit, profit memory and portfolio exit-coordination neighborhoods are closed with no new causal held-position checkpoint.
whole_map_recomparison.program_5: Static/dynamic allocation, capital growth, risk caps, slots, drawdown governors, component state, one-way complementarity and capital ownership are closed; Unit 101 specifically forbids another capital-ownership successor.
whole_map_recomparison.program_7: Router label alignment and evidence/meta audits have no retained seed and cannot add economic starts.
whole_map_recomparison.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7. Do not automatically open another candlestick, body, high-low, threshold, duration, clock, symbol or direction variant.

distinction_from_closed_work.unit_029_us30_compression_break: Unit 029 required a twelve-M5 realized-volatility compression threshold and a first quote outside a twelve-bar high-low range. Unit 102 uses no volatility, high, low or breakout and requires an opposite-colour H1 open-close body to envelop the immediately prior body.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_031_us100_failed_extreme: Unit 031 required a one-sided penetration and rejection beyond a twenty-four-M5 high-low extreme. Unit 102 ignores highs/lows, uses a two-sided open-close body relation and includes all three indices.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_036_us500_close_location: Unit 036 used one M15 bar's own high-low close location and body fraction thresholds. Unit 102 has no fraction threshold or high-low input and instead measures a strict two-bar change of body control on H1.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_038_us500_ordinal_acceleration: Unit 038 required three same-direction accelerating M15 returns. Unit 102 requires exactly two opposite-colour H1 bodies and no return-magnitude ordering.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_053_us500_monthly_range_break: Unit 053 was a daily close outside a preceding twenty-market-day range. Unit 102 is continuous intraday H1 body containment without a monthly range.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_086_deficit_dislocation: Unit 086 used 12:00-to-18:00 cross-sectional residuals only after native signal-deficit days and entered at 19:00. Unit 102 is single-symbol, all-clock and independent of portfolio signal state.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_093_cross_relative_convergence: Unit 093 used one-H1 cross-index residual z-scores at 17:00 and convergence entries. Unit 102 has no peer symbol in its signal and no z-score, threshold or fixed clock.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_094_round_number_crossing: Unit 094 used tick crossings of absolute price lattices. Unit 102 uses no price level or tick path.

immutable_inputs.manifest_rule: Sort name|bytes|uppercase SHA-256 by name, join with LF and SHA-256 UTF-8 without a trailing LF.

implementation.role: One frozen research aggregation; not a validator, parity checker, test harness, CLI product or trading executable.

fixed_signal.prior_bar: The immediately preceding completed H1 bar.
fixed_signal.signal_bar: The immediately completed H1 bar; both it and the prior bar must be non-doji and their open-close signs must be opposite.
fixed_signal.body_engulf: The signal open-close body inclusively contains the prior open-close body, with at least one containment boundary strict.
fixed_signal.inputs_not_used: High, low, tick volume, real volume, peer symbols, volatility, thresholds and current portfolio state never enter the signal.
fixed_signal.continuity: Prior, signal, entry and every hourly boundary through exit must have exact adjacent epoch deltas of 3600 seconds.
fixed_signal.signal_direction: Sign of signal close minus signal open.
fixed_signal.entry: The next H1 row open after the completed signal; export open is bid and ask is bid plus spread times point.
fixed_signal.exit: The fifth H1 row open after the signal, exactly four physical hours after entry.
fixed_signal.overlap: At most one unresolved observation per symbol. Ignore every otherwise eligible signal through and including that symbol's exit row; the next row may signal.
fixed_signal.period_boundary: Signal and exit must belong to the same frozen period; no imputation or carry across a boundary.

P1_2022H2_2023.role: Direction discovery only; report 2022H2 and 2023 separately.

P4_2026_JAN_MAY.role: Third independent confirmation before the latest holdout.

P5_LATEST_2026_JUN_JUL.role: Latest two completed months; veto only and never direction selection.

premetric_structural_feasibility.scope: Only strict current/prior open-close body geometry and timestamps through the exact t+5 exit boundary were consumed from the Lab-owned copies. No entry/exit price, spread, direction P/L, profit factor, drawdown, gate or verdict was read or calculated.

fixed_cost_proxy.h1_open_semantics: Export open is bid; ask equals bid plus spread points times point.
fixed_cost_proxy.entry_mid: Entry bid plus one half entry spread in price units.
fixed_cost_proxy.exit_mid: Exit bid plus one half exit spread in price units.
fixed_cost_proxy.gross_usd: Direction sign times exit midpoint minus entry midpoint, times contract size and volume.
fixed_cost_proxy.observed_usd: Gross USD minus one half of the entry-plus-exit full-spread price burden times contract size and volume; this equals executable bid/ask economics under the open proxy.
fixed_cost_proxy.double_spread_usd: Gross USD minus the full entry-plus-exit spread price burden times contract size and volume; this is binding.
fixed_cost_proxy.commission_swap_financing: Zero in this fixed four-hour trade-free proxy; any retained seed must later face normal native Tester deal economics.
fixed_cost_proxy.economic_authority: Double-spread USD is binding; gross and observed USD are descriptive.

fixed_metrics.book: Count, gross/observed/double-spread net USD, double-spread wins/losses/zeros, profit factor, maximum closed drawdown USD and percent from $100, net-to-drawdown, minimum balance, win rate, mean and median.
fixed_metrics.ordering: Sort closes by exit epoch, then symbol, then signal epoch before shared closed-balance drawdown.
fixed_metrics.discovery_views: Both P1 direction books pooled, 2022H2/2023, each symbol and each signal side.
fixed_metrics.confirmation_views: Only the P1-selected direction by P2, P3, P4, P5, pooled P2-P4, each symbol and signal side, then full path.
fixed_metrics.zero_profit: Retained in count, neither win nor loss, and excluded from profit-factor numerator and denominator.

requirements: All five Lab-owned input filenames, byte lengths and SHA-256 hashes match the declaration.
Every CSV retains its exact header, row count, first/last time, strictly increasing epoch, finite positive OHLC, valid OHLC geometry, positive tick volume and nonnegative integer spread/real volume.
Point, tick size/value, contract size and minimum/step volume reproduce 0.01/0.01/0.01/1/0.01/0.01 for all symbols.
Reconstruct the exact premetric per-symbol, pooled and P1-split counts with zero boundary exclusion.
Pooled signals/day, unique hours/day, each symbol's signals/day and each side count meet the numeric minima in every period.
P1 pooled double-spread net is strictly positive.
P1 pooled double-spread profit factor is at least 1.10.
P1 pooled double-spread net divided by maximum closed drawdown is at least 1.50.
2022H2 and 2023 double-spread nets are separately positive.
US30, US100 and US500 P1 double-spread nets are separately positive.
UP-signal and DOWN-signal P1 double-spread nets are separately positive.
No symbol supplies more than 80 percent of summed positive P1 symbol net.
fixed_p1_direction_selection_gate.selection: Select at most one passing direction by greater net-to-drawdown, then profit factor, then net USD, then REVERSION before CONTINUATION. P2-P5 economics cannot select or switch direction.
fixed_p1_direction_selection_gate.failure_action: If neither direction passes, calculate no P2-P5 economics and close with no seed.

requirements: Selected-direction double-spread net is positive and profit factor at least 1.05 separately in P2, P3 and P4.
Pooled P2-P4 profit factor is at least 1.10 and net-to-drawdown at least 1.50.
Pooled P2-P4 double-spread net is positive for all three symbols and both signal sides.
Latest P5 double-spread net is nonnegative and profit factor at least 1.00.
Every confirmation and latest requirement passes without changing direction or any signal/cost term.
Full-path double-spread net is positive, profit factor at least 1.10 and net-to-drawdown at least 1.50.
Every period is nonnegative, all three symbols are positive and both signal sides are positive on the full path.
No period supplies more than 65 percent and no symbol more than 80 percent of summed positive net.

fixed_verdict_rules.pass: PASS_H1_BODY_ENGULFING_RETAIN_ONE_OPTIMIZATION_INFORMATION_SEED when integrity/density, one P1 direction, confirmation/latest and full-candidate gates all pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.discovery_failure: FAIL_H1_BODY_ENGULFING_NO_P1_DIRECTION_NO_SEED when integrity/density pass but neither direction passes P1.
fixed_verdict_rules.confirmation_failure: FAIL_H1_BODY_ENGULFING_CONFIRMATION_OR_LATEST_NO_SEED when P1 selects a direction but any later or full gate fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.correction: Any input, environment, design, invocation, implementation, parser or serialization defect is a correction state without economic verdict and without an arbitrary retry cap while this frozen economic contract remains unchanged.

decision_translation.pass: Retain exactly one fixed three-index 0.01-volume four-hour body-engulfing direction as an Optimization information seed. It has no native fill, shared-risk, portfolio, MT5 drawdown, Lab engineering or Live authority and can open only after a complete macro-map comparison.
decision_translation.failure: Retain no signal seed and preserve every current anchor component, signal, order, risk, slot, capital, stop and exit rule.
decision_translation.correction: Correct engineering until one valid process exists; never count a correction as research failure.
